# testing_oas_pattern (Resource)

OASPattern Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "testing_oas_pattern" "my_oaspattern" {
  complex_pattern            = "abc"
  incompatible_pattern       = "...my_incompatible_pattern..."
  invalid_pattern            = "...my_invalid_pattern..."
  oneof_request              = "request1"
  oneof_request_and_response = "request_and_response1"
  oneof_response             = "response1"
  request                    = "request"
  request_and_response       = "request_and_response"
  response                   = "response"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `complex_pattern` (String) complex pattern compilation (^.?([a-z]*|A+|\s|`)$)
- `incompatible_pattern` (String) RE2 incompatible pattern should be skipped
- `invalid_pattern` (String) invalid pattern should be skipped
- `oneof_request` (String) oneOf request only patterns (union of request1 and request2)
- `oneof_request_and_response` (String) <- oneOf request and response patterns (union of request_and_response1 and request_and_response2)
- `oneof_response` (String) oneOf response only patterns (union of response1 and response2)
- `request` (String) request only pattern (request)
- `request_and_response` (String) request and response pattern (request_and_response)
- `response` (String) response only pattern (response)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = testing_oas_pattern.my_testing_oas_pattern
  id = "..."
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import testing_oas_pattern.my_testing_oas_pattern "..."
```
